notes.title: Update Notes(08/08)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685569/80ecc7685d337593af866f15b037aaae6f17b601.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Hello, this is GoldKids.[/b][/p][p]We’re happy to bring you the 1.3.5 update![/p][p]Here are the patch notes:[/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We're working on fixing an error that occurs when launching the game on certain computers. This will be addressed in a future patch.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Cards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]After successfully hacking the subway kiosk, the shop now sells all cards regardless of whether they’ve been unlocked.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gold[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased the amount of gold earned in the tutorial stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with the tutorial boss cutscene.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Spearman would teleport.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve also fixed various minor issues and continue to polish the game.[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or have suggestions,[/p][p]please contact us via our [url="https://discord.gg/eqb9WA8M"]Discord channel[/url] or [url="https://forms.gle/jvbEKRiRX9ebBumQ8"]Google Form[/url].[/p][p]Thank you for playing—we’ll keep working to make the game even more fun![/p]

notes.title: Update Notes (08/02)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685569/80ecc7685d337593af866f15b037aaae6f17b601.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is GoldKids.[/p][p]We’re happy to bring you Update 1.3![/p][p]Many people have been playing our game, and we’re truly grateful for all the support.[/p][p]If you enjoy this update, we’d really appreciate it if you could leave a review on Steam![/p][p]This update brings several new features and content.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Features[/b][/h2][hr][/hr][list][*][p][b]Chroma[/b] has been added.[/p][p]Chroma is a new item that grants permanent effects once acquired.[/p][p]After defeating a boss, a Chroma Chest will now appear![/p][p]Strengthen yourself further with various Chromas![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Gameplay[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A tutorial stage has been added.[/p][p]This stage helps first-time players and disappears after it's cleared once.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Chroma[/b][/h3][list][*][p]6 new Chromas have been added.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Cards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Enhanced cards now display visual effects to show they’re upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]“Dagger Slash” can now appear as a card reward.[/p][/*][*][p]A new animation plays when treasure chests appear.[/p][/*][*][p]The area of effect for "Moonrend" has been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]A spawn animation has been added when enemies appear.[/p][/*][*][p]The HP of the Foreman, Remnant Storm, and Mechanical Decree has been slightly increased.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The UI becomes more gamepad-friendly when using a controller.[/p][p]Accordingly, the default button layout for gamepads has also been updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Other[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some sound effects have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugs have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The log consent window has been moved to the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve also fixed various minor issues and continue to polish the game.[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or have suggestions,[/p][p]please contact us via our [url="https://discord.gg/eqb9WA8M"]Discord channel[/url] or [url="https://forms.gle/jvbEKRiRX9ebBumQ8"]Google Form[/url].[/p][p]Thank you for playing—we’ll keep working to make the game even more fun![/p]

notes.title: 07/29 Hotfix Update [Ver.1.2.1]
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685569/b8caffa9e1515ed8ce2b2132ee126870a3b8fe53.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is GoldKids.[/p][p]This is a hotfix addressing several issues discovered recently.[/p][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash issue that occurred when starting the game.
We are working to resolve this problem. If the issue persists, we’ve added a section in the [url="https://forms.gle/jvbEKRiRX9ebBumQ8"]Google Form[/url] to submit your logs and crash reports—your help is greatly appreciated.[/p][/*][*][p]Restarting the game now takes you to the lobby instead of the main screen.[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][h3][b]Cards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where unlocking Glaive and choosing a deck preset would cause the Glaive to disappear, requiring players to re-enter the lobby.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where defeating a boss with "Stormdash" gave excessive rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain enemies died with a delay.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Others[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Further adjusted sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Additionally, a replacement of the gamepad icon images is planned.[/p][p]We’ve also fixed various minor issues and continue to polish the game.[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or have suggestions,[/p][p]please contact us via our [url="https://discord.gg/eqb9WA8M"]Discord channel[/url] or [url="https://forms.gle/jvbEKRiRX9ebBumQ8"]Google Form[/url][/p][p]Thank you for playing—we’ll keep working to make the game even more fun![/p]

notes.title: Update Notes (07/29)
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685569/80ecc7685d337593af866f15b037aaae6f17b601.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, this is GoldKids.[/p][p]We're happy to bring you our second patch.[/p][p]We’re aware that there are still many areas for improvement, and we’re steadily working on refining various elements.[/p][p]Here are the details of Patch 1.2:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]General[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where aim assist was missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the overall game tempo.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player would be launched during certain actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player could pass through walls in specific situations.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Cards[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several description errors.[/p][/*][*][p]If you enter the station without choosing a starter card pack, the Dagger deck will now be selected automatically.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gold[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted gold balance slightly.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Enemies[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Rebalanced difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that occurred during boss death cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where enemies could pass through walls in certain situations.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Improved the card pack, add card, deck list, and deck removal screens.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the upgrade UI.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Others[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added and adjusted several sound effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve also fixed various minor issues and continue to polish the game.[/p][p]If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or have suggestions,[/p][p]please contact us via our [url="https://discord.gg/eqb9WA8M"]Discord channel[/url] or [url="https://forms.gle/jvbEKRiRX9ebBumQ8"]Google Form[/url].[/p][p]Thank you for playing—we’ll keep working to make the game even more fun![/p]

notes.title: Update Notes (07/26)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45685569/a3b1523476fc3b2aa9667dc38f4fe4f463ec535c.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello, this is GoldKids.

We're happy to greet you with the Day 1 Patch.

The 1.1 patch includes several bug fixes and improvements.

Here are the details of the 1.1 patch:

[/p][h2]Achievements[/h2][h3]achievements have been added! Try clearing various challenges![/h3][p][/p][h3]Cards[/h3][p]
- The starting card pool has been expanded to offer more diverse experiences.

[/p][h3]Enemies[/h3][p]
- Fixed some enemies that died with a delay.
- We are continuing to resolve similar issues with other enemies.

[/p][h3]UI[/h3][p]
- Fixed an issue where the card list would sometimes overflow outside the screen.

[/p][h3]Sound[/h3][p]
- Fixed an issue where some sound effects would not play.

We’ve also fixed several minor issues and are continuing to improve.

If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or have suggestions,

please let us know via our [url="https://discord.gg/eqb9WA8M"]\[Discord][/url]channel or [url="https://forms.gle/jvbEKRiRX9ebBumQ8"]\[Google Form] [/url].[/p][p]Thank you for playing. We'll keep working to make the game even better.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]We have fixed the issue that prevented the game from launching after the patch. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix Update [Ver. 0102]
notes.content:
Hello, this is GoldKids.
This is a hotfix update for several issues discovered since launch.



[b]Gold[/b]

[list]
[*] Shop Reroll Cost: 30G -> 20G
[*] Shop Card Removal Cost: 80G -> 60G
[/list]


[b]Enemies[/b]

[list]
[*] The attack range of the Suicide Drone has been reduced.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]


[list]
[*] The size of the interaction icon has been increased.
[/list]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where a charging skill could be infinitely activated during a cutscene.
[/list]


If you encounter any bugs, crashes, or have suggestions,
please let us know through our [url=https://discord.gg/eqb9WA8M]Discord[/url] channel. Your feedback is greatly appreciated.
Thank you!
